description: This file defines the MetadataModel class and related classes for managing serialization, proxies, and type aliases within the Orleans code generator. It includes data structures for representing type metadata, a prefix tree for compound type aliases, and internal logic for managing these structures.

classes.name: MetadataModel
classes.description: A class that holds metadata about serializable types, invokable interfaces, proxies, and type aliases used in Orleans code generation.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasTree
classes.description: A prefix tree structure representing compound type aliases for efficient lookup and management.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasComponent
classes.description: A struct representing a component of a compound type alias, which can be a string or a type symbol.

classes.name: Either
classes.description: A generic struct representing a value that can be either of two types, used for handling string or type symbol in alias components.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new root node of the CompoundTypeAliasTree with no key or value.

methods.name: GetChildOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a child node for a given key, or null if it does not exist.

methods.name: TryGetChild
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a child node for a given key, returning true if found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new alias component or path to the tree, with overloads for different key types.

methods.name: AddInternal
methods.description: Internal method to add a node with a key and optional value, handling existing nodes.
